brief: Aligns a text in a field of a given width: pads it on the left, on the right or on both sides with a chosen character.
detail: It is the alignment helper behind the padding methods of stzString. Build one with new stzStringAligner("abc") over a text. Each in-place verb (AlignLeft, AlignRight, AlignCenter, PadLeft, PadRight, PadBoth) changes the text it holds and has a passive twin that returns the padded text (AlignedLeft, AlignedRight, AlignedCenter, PaddedLeft ...). Widths count characters, not bytes, so Hebrew, Arabic and emoji align like any other text, and a width smaller than the text changes nothing. Do not pass a stzString object you still need: the first in-place edit empties it.
